Deep woods and steep paths, where highwaymen lie in wait.
column2: 林深路险，常有剪径之徒。

column1: Grim winds howl through the valley; merchants pale at its name.
column2: 谷中阴风惨惨，商旅闻之色变。

column1: A thousand li of reeds, the water fort locked in fog.
Bones bleach in the fields; for a thousand li no cock crows.
column2: 白骨露于野，千里无鸡鸣。

column1: Stone horses line the tomb road; at night, the clash of arms.
column2: 石马石人列于墓道，夜有金戈之声。

column1: The earth fell a hundred zhang, and below lies another world.
column2: 地陷百丈，其下别有洞天。

column1: In the eighth month the northern sky is already full of snow.
Towers in the sea mist, real and false beyond telling.
The hill of Kunlun, the lower capital of the High Lord.
column2: 昆仑之丘，是实惟帝之下都。

column1: Above the azure, below the springs: both lost in the vast.
column2: 上穷碧落下黄泉，两处茫茫皆不见。
